text:
julia: Quick heads-up — PR #7241 needs two approvals to make the 18:00 PT hotpatch cutoff. This is the tiny rollback fix for tokenize edge case. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/7241 @mike @dana can you eyeball?

mike: on it, will do a pass in ~30m. if it's quick I can approve.

dana: I can take a look now, ping me if you want me to prioritize.

emma: flagged a flaky e2e in CI earlier for master, fyi — not sure if this PR will trigger it. cc @sre-oncall

julia: thanks — PR is just a one-line guard, shouldn't touch infra. Still want two approvals though before we merge.

mike: quick question — is this safe to cherry-pick to the dedicated branch as well? (we'll need parity)

julia: yes, I'll open the backport after merge. for this cutoff we only need main hotpatch deployed.

dana: looked through, small nit: can you rename variable `s` -> `tokenBuf` for readability? otherwise LGTM.

julia: done, pushed. thanks.

mike: reading now... ok, approve from me. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: build #5182 for PR 7241 passed checks on linux, mac. Staging deploy scheduled if merged.

emma: approving after CI rerun — I want to confirm the e2e didn't flake this time. running full suite now.

sre-oncall: if we merge and deploy after cutoff window we'll need on-call handover. recommend merge before 17:45 PT to allow soak.

emma: e2e passed on this run. approving. :white_check_mark:

julia: two approvals secured, thank you everyone. can someone with merge rights do the merge and kick the hotpatch job? @mike?

mike: merging now and triggering deploy job.

deploy-bot: hotpatch deploy job started for PR 7241 — job id 2026-03-18_02:15. Notifying oncall.

sre-oncall: watching deploy. please post any regressions here immediately.

mike: merged and queued. will follow up with rollback plan in case of issues.

julia: nailed it. thanks for the quick turnaround. :rocket:
